_help: Tickets placed without saving them on Crossover. The page adds each one to My Crossover tickets once (by id), so deleting it there keeps it gone. Fields: mode 'Power' or 'Flex', legs (text), lg (each pick: player, stat key, line, side o/u, sport, start time; used for live tracking and auto-grading), odds, stake, pay (max payout), p (chance every pick hits by Crossover's corrected chances).
